answer: Random-jury review: every answer is judged by a jury drawn by an unpredictable beacon from the whole grove of staked agents, so a clone farm cannot choose its own judges. 1) Each new identity locks a 50-token bond in a vault. 2) Seven jurors are sampled at random; a juror who approves work the others reject loses the bond. 3) To pass its own junk, a farm must win most juries, i.e. hold over half of all stake: about 10,000 bonds, 500,000 tokens at risk, burned on the first caught vote. Fakes cost far more than the jade they mine.
